items.title: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets
items.summary: A new XRPL amendment proposal would let institutions encrypt token balances and transfer amounts while still giving issuers, auditors and regulators selective access.

items.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
items.summary: If a minority chain appears this weekend, buyers could replay signed fork-coin sales on bitcoin itself, making doing nothing the safest move until the chains can be separated.

items.title: BitMEX sale collapsed as buyers balked at founder ownership and shrinking business
items.summary: Potential buyers, including Exodus, passed on BitMEX amid concerns over founder ownership and its shrinking business, according to a source familiar.

items.title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
items.summary: After months of public warnings from onchain analysts, the prediction market is moving to time-weighted prices to make artificial price pushes too costly.

items.title: Ethereum staking token weETH splits from restaking as rewards debate heats up
items.summary: The move separates ordinary Ethereum staking from higher-risk restaking exposure as a new proposal to cap validator rewards divides the staking sector.

items.title: Live updates: 'This can't last forever': Mulling bitcoin's lame price action as risk markets rally
items.summary: The U.S. lost 23,000 in July, the first such loss since February. Expectations had been for a gain of 80,000 jobs.

items.title: Bitcoin price tags $65.3K August high as low US jobs numbers cool Fed rate bets
items.summary: Bitcoin hit month-to-date highs above $65,000 as risk-assets gained on low US nonfarm payrolls data.

items.title: Bitcoin price coils under $65K as US PMI data brings new ‘stagflation’ warning
items.summary: Bitcoin price action stayed compressed in an ongoing divergence from stocks and gold while US PMI data sparked fresh talk of “stagflation.”

items.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers

items.title: Domestic stablecoins could boost demand for dollar-backed tokens: IMF
items.summary: IMF first deputy managing director Dan Katz says users may favor digital dollars for their liquidity, network effects and cross-border acceptance.

items.title: Trump Media pulls back from crypto, scraps Crypto.com's CRO token treasury deal
items.summary: The Truth Social parent company is refocusing on media and its pending merger with a fusion energy firm, as the digital asset treasury boom has lost its steam.

items.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin director Justin Mateen buys nearly $2 million of ABTC stock
items.summary: Mateen purchased more than 306,000 shares across two days following the company's quarterly earnings, lifting his stake to more than 492,000 shares.

items.title: U.S. widens Iran crypto crackdown with sanctions on two exchanges
items.summary: The Treasury's OFAC targeted Shelbit and Aban Tether as Washington continues its effort to cut Tehran's access to crypto and foreign currency.

items.title: A part of FTX survived, and it’s the case for the CLARITY Act
items.summary: When FTX collapsed, the parts of it bound by law survived. Mainstream finance is now converging with digital assets, and the law built to protect it the same way is the one the Senate did not pass this week, argues Bullish's Randi Abernethy.

items.title: Russia cracks down on unlicensed crypto exchanges it claims are linked to Ukraine
items.summary: The FSB said at least 20 individuals were arrested in connection with a ring that scammed an undetermined number of Russian citizens.
